source_locator: R393: p. 177, 180; R643: listing under the XLVII Panzer Corps heading
current_activity: The 26th Volksgrenadier Division, in the West Wall at the Our, is to bridge the river at Gemünd
notes: Event date: CMH Ardennes ch. 8 p. 177: "The 26th Volks Grenadier Division (Generalmajor Heinz Kokott) already was deployed in the Eifel sector of the West Wall adjacent to the Our"; p. 180: "the 26th Volks Grenadier Division intended to enter the two southernmost roads by throwing a bridge across at Gemünd"; Nafziger 944GLAA (15 December 1944): "26th Volks Grenadier Division: Oberst H. Kokott". Event definition: the opening of the offensive on 16 December. Event support: two source families: CMH and Nafziger. Location: Dasburg with a precision of 10 km, a town point near the Gemünd bridge site (Gemünd could not be geocoded). Location approximate: a town point near the bridge site. Location support: CMH names Gemünd and the Our sector. Commander: Generalmajor Heinz Kokott. Opponents: US VIII Corps (28th Infantry Division, 110th Infantry).
